howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以黑底、CRT 网格扫描线、薄荷绿大字和命令行风格展示内容，适合制作 CLI、agent 或开发工具的测评幻灯片。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 制作关于命令行工具、AI agent 或开发工具的测评幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这个 deck 展示三个 CLI 工具的 benchmark 对比。
say.note: Claude 会使用柱状图和 tag 来呈现数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will display content in a black background with CRT grid scanlines, mint green large text, and a command-line style, suitable for making review slides for CLI, agent, or dev tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a review slide deck about command-line tools, AI agents, or developer tools.

say_en.text: Make a review slide for git diff using the Cyber Terminal Deck style.
Use this deck to show a benchmark comparison of three CLI tools.
say_en.note: Claude will use bar charts and tags to present the data.
